name: legafy
description: Pre-counsel compliance screening for Indian jurisdictions. Isolated state code paths, no fabricated statute citations, and a hard stop when a lawyer is genuinely required.

legafy_url.title: Legafy server URL

legafy_token.description: Bearer token issued by your Legafy deployment. DEVELOPER_FREE tokens can screen ideas; drafting documents needs a PREMIUM or ENTERPRISE token.
